messages:
alex: Quick flag from sales: ACME wants to accelerate their pilot by 4 weeks and needs tenant-level model lock + basic audit trail. Could force a scope shuffle for the next milestone. Need a fast decision on what we can realistically fence.
nina: Can we get clarity on MUST vs NICE? Sales said 'lock + rollback' is must, dashboards are nice-to-have.
ale x: typo -> alex: Must = tenant model lock API + rollbacks. Nice = admin UI + per-tenant telemetry.
leo: Implementation note: runtime change + tenant config store + rollout controls. Biggest risk is cache invalidation semantics for live KV cache and violation of routing policies.
sam: UX: if we do API-only for MVP, admin UI can be a thin client that calls the same endpoints. Could push full admin analytics to V1.
jin: Engineering scoping: API + migration + rollback hooks = ~6 dev-weeks if we do full canary and test matrix. If we accept API-only with manual rollbacks, we can probably do 2-3 dev-weeks. Need a short spike to confirm.
legal: One contract ask: audit logs must be tamper-evident for the pilot. We can ship simple append-only logs but need retention terms. That sounds like a V1 item unless ACME signs pilot with limited retention.
nina: Sales feedback: ACME may sign pilot if we commit to delivery before their user test window. They're willing to accept limited retention (30 days) for pilot.
ale x: alex: Proposal for scope split:
- Shipable MVP (pilot): tenant model lock API, basic append-only audit entries (30d retention), manual rollback doc, thin admin UI (toggle + status).
- Defer to V1: long-term retention & export, per-tenant telemetry dashboards, dedicated routing rule editor, automated canary/rollback policies.
leo: That split seems reasonable. Engineering asks for a decision on automation level: manual rollback vs automated canary. Manual rollback is much faster.
jin: Spike plan: 1) validate cache invalidation cases, 2) validate idempotency of pin calls, 3) draft migration for existing tenant configs. I'll run spike today and post results in thread.
sam: I'll deliver a v0 wireframe and an error flow doc by EOD. Wireframe will show: tenant list -> pinned model column -> actions.
legal: I'll draft a pilot contract clause for 30d retention and audit obligations; will post in thread for review.
ale x: Milestone/timeline impact: if we prioritize this into the next milestone, we need to move 2 V1 tickets (routing-rule-editor, telemetry export) to the following milestone. We should call out stakeholders and acceptance criteria now.
nina: Sales OK to move those V1 items later if we get pilot slot. This is revenue+reference customer.
leo: Ops note: We should add an SLO for rollback latency in the pilot doc (target <5m to unpin).
jin: Testing note: need acceptance tests covering concurrent pin/unpin + active KV cache expiry. I'll add to test plan spike.
sam: UX question: what happens on model deprecation? Should pinning prevent deprecated model usage forever? Suggest pinned models must be valid and service will reject pins to deprecated model versions. Add rejected-pin error with clear message.
ale x: Agreed. Add to acceptance criteria: 1) pin/unpin API works, 2) audit entries created for pin/unpin with user metadata, 3) pinning rejected for deprecated models, 4) manual rollback documented, 5) 30d retention for pilot logs.
legal: I'll loop in privacy for the retention clause.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created for 2025-06-12 10:00 (pilot delivery decision).
alex: Action items recap: Jin: spike (today), Sam: wireframe + error flows (EOD), Leo: ops SLO doc (2d), Legal: pilot clause draft (2d), Nina: update sales ask + signoff timeline. We'll reconvene after spike and wireframe to finalise fence.
nina: I'll push a short customer note template in the channel for expectations.
jin: Spike underway, will post outcomes here.
alex: If spike >3d risk we revert to 'API-only' MVP and drop thin UI to V1. Keep coordinated communications with sales. :eyes:
